Title: LSJ : Heart of Darkness + Daring the Dawn

Messages.Author: Mechadick
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with Fortitude and Serpentis ( like UNRE for example )
put a heart of Darkness with daring the dawn to be un-blockable .
Since the action is succesful and the dammage occur after the action ,
does the dammage is normal or aggravated ?

Thank You ,

Mechadick

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
The damage is normal.

Name: Heart of Darkness
[AH, FN]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Serpentis
[ser] Put this card on the acting vampire. Aggravated damage taken by this
vampire is changed to normal damage. Any minion may burn this card as a (D)
action.
[SER] As above, and this vampire may prevent 1 damage each combat.

Name: Daring the Dawn
[Sabbat, SW, FN]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Fortitude
[for] Vampires cannot block this action. This vampire takes 2 aggravated
damage (not preventable) after the action is complete.
[FOR] As above, but this acting vampire takes 1 aggravated damage.

You can even use DtD to get the HoD action through.

c.f. Concordance + Force of Will

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:


Normal. A vampire with Heart of Darkness, Armor of Terra, or Concordance treats
*all* aggravated damage as normal. It doesn't matter whether it is during or
after an action.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


I think he was asking if using Daring the Dawn *on* a Heart of Darkness action
would be kosher. That is, would the Heart of Darkness kick in before DtD's
damage is dealt. I think the answer is yes. That's what GreySeer said, and
I'm inclined to agree with him.
